'''[[Tso Sook Drane]]''' was the [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] of [[Armo Drane]], a [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] who had been convicted of a crime and was being transported to a [[Detention area|detention]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] via the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. Her husband wrote a letter to her and attempted to have a guard named [[Wembly]] send it to her. In the letter he wished her and someone named [[Jollar]] well and expressed his wish to explain his criminal actions to them someday. The letter was recovered aboard ''Purge'' after its occupants were decimated by a [[plague]] so it is unlikely that it reached her before it was released to the public for academic purposes in relation to the history of ''Purge''.
